title: Stress, and How to Beat It

groups.instructionMy: မဖတ်မီ ဆွေးနွေးရန်

items.prompt: 1. How do you feel when the deadline for the assignment is tomorrow but you haven’t finished it yet?
items.promptMy: တာဝန်ပေးစာတင်ရမည့် နောက်ဆုံးရက်က မနက်ဖြန်ဖြစ်သော်လည်း မပြီးသေးသောအခါ မည်သို့ခံစားရသနည်း။

items.prompt: 2. When do you usually feel stressed?
items.promptMy: မည်သည့်အချိန်တွင် စိတ်ဖိစီးလေ့ရှိသနည်း။

items.prompt: 3. How do you usually react to stress?
items.promptMy: စိတ်ဖိစီးမှုကို မည်သို့ တုံ့ပြန်လေ့ရှိသနည်း။

groups.instruction: A. Give a full-sentence answer to each question below.
groups.instructionMy: အောက်ပါမေးခွန်းတစ်ခုစီကို ဝါကျပြည့်ဖြင့် ဖြေပါ။

items.prompt: 1. List various forms of stress.
2. Why is it likely to have infections like colds and flu when we feel stressed?
items.promptMy: စိတ်ဖိစီးသောအခါ အအေးမိနှင့် တုပ်ကွေးကဲ့သို့ ကူးစက်ရောဂါများ အဘယ်ကြောင့် ပိုဖြစ်လွယ်သနည်း။

items.prompt: 3. What happens when we laugh?
items.promptMy: ရယ်မောသောအခါ မည်သည့်အရာများ ဖြစ်ပေါ်သနည်း။

items.prompt: 4. How can we remove bitter unpleasant feelings?
items.promptMy: ခါးသီးမနှစ်မြို့ဖွယ် ခံစားချက်များကို မည်သို့ ဖယ်ရှားနိုင်သနည်း။

items.prompt: 5. What can we experience by practising yoga or reciting a short prayer?
items.promptMy: ယောဂလေ့ကျင့်ခြင်း သို့မဟုတ် ဆုတောင်းစာတိုရွတ်ဆိုခြင်းဖြင့် မည်သည့်အတွေ့အကြုံ ရနိုင်သနည်း။

items.prompt: 6. Among the seven ways recommended in the passage to reduce stress, which one do you like best? Why?
items.promptMy: စာပိုဒ်တွင် အကြံပြုထားသော စိတ်ဖိစီးမှုလျှော့ချနည်း ခုနစ်မျိုးအနက် မည်သည့်နည်းကို အနှစ်သက်ဆုံးဖြစ်သနည်း။ အဘယ်ကြောင့်နည်း။

items.prompt: 7. State a cause of stress that is not mentioned in the passage.
items.promptMy: စာပိုဒ်တွင် မဖော်ပြထားသော စိတ်ဖိစီးမှုအကြောင်းရင်းတစ်ခုကို ဖော်ပြပါ။

items.prompt: 8. State three more ways of relieving stress.
9. What do you usually do when you feel stressed?
items.promptMy: စိတ်ဖိစီးသောအခါ မည်သည့်အရာကို လုပ်လေ့ရှိသနည်း။

groups.instruction: B. Complete each blank with an appropriate expression.
groups.instructionMy: ကွက်လပ်တစ်ခုစီတွင် သင့်လျော်သော အသုံးအနှုန်းကို ဖြည့်ပါ။

items.prompt: 1. If you ______ for a few minutes before bedtime, you may fall asleep easily.
2. After the earthquake, the victims were found ______ under the big table.
3. We should learn to accept criticism without ______.
4. The two friends sometimes find time to meet up to ______ and see a film.
5. The accident left him paralysed, but after exercising, he could ______ his legs.
6. She always responds to things calmly, but now she is ______ by stress.
7. After a long tiring day, I took a warm bath to ______ myself.
8. The couple could finally find a way to ______.
9. Ko Min wrote his report the whole night to ______.
10. You simply made a mistake; you don’t need to ______.
1. One particular accident / incident that sticks in my mind is my first day at school.
2. The museum is having a perspective / retrospective exhibit of the artist’s early works.
3. We are conscientious / conscious of the generation gap problems between youths and their parents.
4. I didn’t mean to break it — it was an accident / incident.
5. The drought may seriously affect / effect the central part of Myanmar.
6. We drove along the muddy lane / line to reach the farmhouse.
7. Today’s youths should be more conscientious / conscious about their own learning.
8. Modern farming methods can have an adverse affect / effect on the environment.
9. The train was delayed because a tree had fallen across the lane / line.
10. Let’s look at the traffic congestion problem from a different perspective / retrospective.

groups.instruction: Complete each sentence with the correct future form of the verb given in brackets.
groups.instructionMy: ကွင်းအတွင်းရှိ ကြိယာကို သင့်လျော်သော အနာဂတ်ကာလပုံစံဖြင့် ပြောင်းပြီး ဝါကျတစ်ခုစီကို ဖြည့်ပါ။

items.prompt: 1. Can you wait a few minutes? I ______ (drive) you to the airport.
2. I’ve sold my bike because I ______ (buy) a car.
3. Sorry, I made a mistake. I promise that I ______ (not, do) it again.
4. Look at those boys playing football! They ______ (break) the window.
5. ______ (you, have) your birthday party this Saturday?
6. This time next week, I ______ (sunbathe) in Bali.
7. ______ (you, go) shopping? We’ve run out of milk.
8. Look at the fuel gauge. We ______ (run out) of petrol before we reach home.
9. I don’t think I ______ (see) Thuzar at the concert tonight.
10. ______ (you, water) the plants while I’m away?
11. We ______ (hold) a team-building meeting in our school by this time next Monday.
12. I think the hotel ______ (provide) a buffet breakfast.
13. After checking the schedule, I ______ (email) it to you straight away.
14. Do you think you ______ (still work) here in five years’ time?
15. If you tell them the truth, they ______ (forgive) you.

choices: (b) Listening to music is good for stress management.

items.prompt: 1. There is no link between our emotions and music.
2. In order to reduce stress, slow and quiet music is better than other types of music.
3. You don’t need to listen to classical music if you don’t like it.
4. You shouldn’t listen to music if you are extremely stressed.
5. Though you are busy, you can listen to music while driving, taking a shower or walking the dog.
6. If you are feeling stressed, you shouldn’t sing.
7. You can sleep well if you listen to music at bedtime.
